title: Jonah and the Uniform
author: Sebastian Whitlock
blurb: Paloma Underhill, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
